notes: Device icons; IPv6 addresses; a Hostname column (now also asked of each device over mDNS); friendly Apple model names like "iPad Pro 11-inch (2nd gen)"; "Nintendo device"-style names for devices that don't announce one; and a Last Seen column, with devices from earlier scans listed as offline (Scan → Show Offline Devices). Scan → Scan Automatically lets you rescan every minute up to every 30 minutes, with a countdown in the new status bar. Right-click the column headers to show or hide columns.
